diagnostics: Factory-grade diagnostics — ISTA/D (BMW) and XENTRY (Mercedes); fault codes traced before repair ("test first, fix once")

oilChangeRecommendation: German Car Depot's own general recommendation, given to every oil-change customer: change the engine oil every 5,000 miles or 6 months. This is GCD's shop recommendation, not a BMW or Mercedes-Benz requirement.
nextOilChangeAppointment: After an oil change, GCD books a tentative appointment for the next oil change 6 months later.
serviceRecords: GCD provides customers their service records on request.
vehicleHistoryReview: Before recommending maintenance, GCD reviews the vehicle's available service-history report by VIN.
engineOils: GCD's bulk engine oils are Liqui Moly Top Tec 6200 SAE 0W-20, Liqui Moly Special Tec LL SAE 5W-30 and Liqui Moly Leichtlauf High Tech SAE 5W-40, kept in gravity tanks refilled by GCD's Liqui Moly supplier. When a vehicle calls for a specification these three do not cover, GCD special-orders an oil for that specification from its parts distributors, choosing the Liqui Moly product for that specification where Liqui Moly offers one, in the quantity the vehicle needs.
